selection_process: Shortlisting of candidates will be based on the percentage of marks obtained in the prescribed qualification applicable to the respective trade/discipline. || In case two or more candidates secure the same percentage of marks, relative merit will be decided based on seniority in age. || Shortlisted candidates will be issued an offer of Internship Training through the PMIS portal and must appear for certificate verification on the date mentioned in the offer letter. || Certificate verification requires original certificates for proof of age, qualification, caste, and disability (if any), along with self-attested copies of the same. || On successful completion of certificate verification, candidates will be provisionally inducted for internship training, subject to medical fitness.
